MD5 hızlıdır: tek bir GPU saniyede milya: MD5 is fast: a single GPU tries billions of guesses per second. No salt → identical passwords produce identical hashes, so precomputed tables work.
MFA varsa yalnızca parola yetmez. Olağan: With MFA, a password alone isn't enough. An unusual location/device raises an alert.
NAT özel adresi genel adresle değiştirir: NAT replaces the private address with the public one and records the connection in its table. TTL drops by one.
Normalde trafik doğrudan ağ geçidine gid: Normally, traffic goes directly to the gateway.

Parola + ikinci faktör, ardından güvenli: Password + second factor, then a secure session cookie.

Personel internete denetimli çıkış yapar: Staff reach the internet through controlled egress; outbound traffic is filtered too.

Sahte mesaj → sahte giriş sayfası → çalı: Fake message → fake login page → stolen password → unauthorised login; MFA breaks the chain.

Saldırgan iki taraf arasına girer; şifre: An attacker gets between the two sides; how do encryption and certificate validation defeat this?

Saldırgan kurumun adını taklit eden bir: The attacker sends a message impersonating the organisation's name.
Saldırgan yerel ağda sahte adres çözümle: The attacker broadcasts fake address resolution replies on the local network so traffic comes to them.
Saldırgan yorum alanına betik içeren bir: The attacker submits text containing a script into the comment field.

scrypt bilerek yavaş ve bellek yoğundur:: scrypt is deliberately slow and memory-hard: the cost of guessing rises thousands of times.
SIEM olayları ilişkilendirir (aynı kulla: The SIEM correlates events (same user, new process, outbound connection) and assigns a severity.
sızıntı olsa bile her parola ayrı ayrı v: even after a leak, every password must be cracked separately and at great cost
SPF/DKIM/DMARC kontrollerinden geçebilen: The email is delivered because it uses a look-alike domain that can pass SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks.

Sunucu kendi geçici açık anahtarını gönd: The server sends its own ephemeral public key. Both sides can now compute the same shared secret; the eavesdropper can't.
Sunucu kendi sıra numarasını seçer ve is: The server picks its own sequence number and acknowledges the client's SYN. State: SYN_RECEIVED.
Sunucu sertifikasını ve el sıkışmanın im: The server sends its certificate and the handshake signature. The browser validates the chain up to a trusted CA (the domain must match).
Switch, MAC tablosuna bakarak çerçeveyi: The switch checks its MAC table and forwards the frame only to the router's port.
Şifresiz (HTTP) trafikse saldırgan okuya: If the traffic is unencrypted (HTTP), the attacker can read and change it.
Tarayıcı bir HTTP isteği gönderir: yönte: The browser sends an HTTP request: method (GET), path (/profil), headers (Host, Cookie, User-Agent).
Tarayıcı bir sayfayı nasıl ister, sunucu: How does a browser request a page, and how does the server respond?
Tarayıcı HTML'i ayrıştırır, CSS/JS kayna: The browser parses the HTML, fetches CSS/JS resources with extra requests and renders the page.
Tarayıcı ile sunucu, dinleyenlerin çözem: How do a browser and a server agree on a shared key that eavesdroppers can't work out?
Tarayıcı sertifikayı güvenilir bir CA'ya: The browser can't chain the certificate to a trusted CA and drops the connection. HSTS prevents downgrading to HTTP.
Temizlik, kurtarma ve 'öğrenilen dersler: Cleanup, recovery and 'lessons learned'. A new detection rule is added to the SIEM.
